description:
Are you passionate about developing the next generation of leaders at scale? Do you thrive on creating transformative learning experiences that shape organizational culture? AWS is seeking an exceptional Senior Learning & Development Partner to help drive our flagship leadership development programs: Day 1 Leader and Day 1 Culture.

In this role, you will be a key contributor to the strategy, design, and continuous improvement of AWS's core leadership development initiatives that impact thousands of leaders globally. You will partner with program managers, learning specialists, and senior stakeholders to design and deliver world-class development experiences. This role requires a unique blend of strategic thinking, hands-on program design expertise, and deep knowledge of adult learning and leadership development.

The ideal candidate will have a proven track record of designing and scaling leadership development programs in fast-paced, high-growth environments. You will partner closely with AWS senior leaders, HR Business Partners, and cross-functional stakeholders to ensure our programs drive measurable impact on leader effectiveness and organizational culture.

Key job responsibilities
Program Design & Strategy

Contribute to the end-to-end strategy and execution for Day 1 Leader and Day 1 Culture programs across AWS globally
Help define program vision, success metrics, and multi-year roadmap aligned with AWS business priorities and culture goals
Drive continuous improvement through data analysis, participant feedback, and industry best practices
Identify opportunities to scale programs to meet the needs of AWS's rapid growth while maintaining quality and impact
Learning Design & Delivery

Design and develop program content incorporating adult learning principles, leadership research, and Amazon's Leadership Principles
Drive innovation in program design, incorporating new modalities (virtual, hybrid, experiential learning)
Maintain high quality standards for all program materials, facilitator guides, and participant experiences
Support program logistics, technology platforms, and vendor relationships
Stakeholder Management & Influence

Partner with AWS senior leadership to align program content and delivery with business needs
Collaborate with HR Business Partners, Talent Management, and other PXT teams to ensure integrated talent solutions
Build strong relationships with internal facilitators and subject matter experts
Present program results and recommendations to senior leadership audiences
Measurement & Impact

Establish and track key performance indicators for program effectiveness and business impact
Conduct regular program evaluations and translate insights into actionable improvements, partnering with Research Science
Build business cases for program investments and demonstrate ROI to stakeholders
Use data to identify trends, gaps, and opportunities in leadership development across AWS

About the team
Diverse Experiences AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn't followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don't let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS? Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world's most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that's why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture Here at AWS, it's in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Mentorship & Career Growth We're continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth's Best Employer. That's why you'll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there's nothing we can't achieve in the cloud.

description:
How would you like to be a part of Earth’s most customer-centric company? You would work with teams of front-line responders who support the operations of some of the world’s most powerful data centers. Our Data Center Engineering Operations team maintain and operate our critical infrastructure systems so that they are prepared to stand up against any situation.

AWS has the world’s largest cloud computing portfolio. As an Amazonian you will work in some of the most sophisticated, safe, and secure data centers in the world. Our Engineering Operations Technicians (EOT’s) help keep them that way by working with the brightest minds from around the globe to help test and implement the newest technology and work practices to meet the demands of a changing market.

We have a passion for learning and evolving, it’s how we have helped define ourselves as leaders in the industry. Let’s work hard, have fun, and make history!

Key job responsibilities
- Daily building rounds to monitor and record information from electrical, mechanical, and fire/life safety equipment to ensure 24/7 reliability and availability
- Monitor Building Management Systems (BMS) and Electrical Power Management System (EPMS)
- Assist in troubleshooting of facility and rack-level events within internal Service Level Agreements (SLA)
- Perform rack installs and rack decommissioning within internal SLA
- Perform PM, troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and repair of electrical and mechanical equipment
- Technical writing to support change management program
- Monitor daily work requests and manage to resolution, and execute projects from conception to completion
- On-site support of contractors, sub-contractors and vendors, ensuring that all work performed is in accordance with established practices, procedures & local legislation
- Work schedule changes depending on specific site needs. Shifts can be up to 12-hours and may rotate on a predefined schedule. Some locations have on-call rotations.
- Role may support more than one location/site.

Work Schedule:
Our Data Centers operate 24/7 and require on-site presence. This position offers two shift schedule options:

Option 1: Weekend Rotation
- Days Worked: Sunday - Tuesday, plus every other Saturday
- Weekly Pattern: Alternates between 3-day and 4-day work weeks
- Shift Hours: 5:30am - 6:00pm (day shift) OR 5:30pm - 6:00am (night shift)

Option 2: Weekday Rotation
- Days Worked: Wednesday - Friday, plus every other Saturday
- Weekly Pattern: Alternates between 3-day and 4-day work weeks
- Shift Hours: 5:30am - 6:00pm (day shift) OR 5:30pm - 6:00am (night shift)

Both schedules follow a rotating pattern where you'll work 3 days one week and 4 days the following week.

Overtime & Pay
- Overtime: Time and a half after 40 hours per week
- Night Shift Differential: 13% additional pay (6:00pm - 6:00am shifts)
- Maximum Hours: 60 hours per week in total (up to 20 hours of overtime)

Physical Requirements:
- Willingness and demonstrated ability to work in the following physical conditions with reasonable accommodations:
- Regularly lift and/or move up to 39 pounds independently
- Participate in group lifts for 40+ pounds
- Maintain balance and perform construction tasks while on a ladder
- Regularly walk, use hands and fingers, handle or feel, reach with hands and arms, stoop, kneel, crouch or crawl, climb stairs, twist, bend, work above shoulders, grasp, carry, push and pull objects into position
- Work in an environment requiring provided ear protection

A day in the life
This role acts as Amazon’s front line when it comes to hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment preventative maintenance (PM) and troubleshooting, reporting to a site’s Data Center Facility Manager (FM). They will maintain, operate, and troubleshoot mission-critical data center facility equipment including stand-by diesel generators and related fuel systems, 3 phase electrical systems such as switchgear, UPS units, PDUs, and wet cell batteries and associated systems. Mechanical equipment includes CRAHU units, centrifugal chillers, cooling towers, water systems, air handlers and associated systems, pumps, and motors. Additional support equipment is included in the scope of the role which includes fire/life safety equipment, building automation systems, and general facilities equipment.

About the team
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

Why AWS?
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Diverse Experiences
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Inclusive Team Culture
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Mentorship & Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

description:
What if quality evaluation happened in real time, as code is written, not as a gate before it ships? What if builders never had to choose between speed and confidence because both were woven into the same moment of creation? What if experience quality, including accessibility, correctness, performance, and consistency, were not a separate discipline but the natural output of how software is developed?

Experience Quality Technologies (EQT) exists to make that future real. We are embedding quality into every stage of the software development lifecycle so that building with confidence becomes the default and every customer can rely on what Amazon ships, regardless of how they interact with our products. Today our capabilities span test generation, defect prevention, production verification, and quality measurement. They serve thousands of teams and they deliver results. The opportunity ahead is to close the distance between writing code and knowing it's right: to strategically apply AI where it creates the most leverage, to rethink evaluation around intent and outcomes without sacrificing the precision and consistency customers depend on, and to bring human judgment and machine speed together so that real-time quality becomes the reality, not the aspiration. We need a leader who can see that full picture, find the right leverage points, and make it inevitable.

We are looking for a Principal Product Manager - Technical to own the end-to-end product portfolio for experience quality at Amazon. This is not a role for someone who wants to optimize an existing roadmap. It is a role for someone who wants to define what quality means in an AI-native development world, determine how it should be measured and enforced at scale, and build the platform that makes it effortless for every builder and undeniable for every customer.

Key job responsibilities
- Define the product vision and strategy for experience quality at Amazon: articulate where the industry is going, where Amazon must lead, and what the unified platform looks like in three to five years. Defend this vision at the highest levels of leadership.

- Converge a fragmented landscape into a coherent product experience. Decide what to build, what to partner on, what to deprecate, and what to leave alone. Turn today's collection of strong individual capabilities into a platform that is greater than the sum of its parts.

- Anticipate the quality implications of AI-native development. As code generation, agentic workflows, and autonomous systems reshape how software is built, define what verification, trust, and confidence mean in that world and ensure our platform evolves ahead of the curve.

- Serve as the voice of the builder. Engage directly with engineering teams, leaders, and partner organizations to understand how they ship, what slows them down, what they fear, and what would make quality feel like a tailwind rather than a gate.

- Drive adoption across organizations you do not own. Quality platforms succeed only when they are used. Build the strategy, the narrative, and the integration model that earns adoption without mandates.

- Establish measurement and accountability frameworks that give leaders at every level clear visibility into experience quality, enable data-driven investment decisions, and create feedback loops that continuously sharpen the quality bar.

- Partner deeply with engineering leadership on architecture, technical trade-offs, and system design. Evaluate proposals for extensibility, cost, and second-order consequences.

- Raise the product management bar across the organization: mentor PMTs, establish operating practices, model strategic thinking, and develop others.

A day in the life
As the Principal PMT, you will set a three-to-five year vision that spans the full quality lifecycle: how defects are prevented before code is written, how output is verified before it ships, how production signals are monitored and fed back to sharpen the bar, and how all of this converges into a single, coherent experience for builders. You will make the build, partner, or deprecate decisions in a crowded internal tooling landscape, converging fragmented capabilities into a platform builders adopt by default rather than adding to the fragmentation.

The right candidate has a track record of building developer-facing platforms at enterprise scale and a deep intuition for how software quality will evolve as AI-generated code becomes the norm. You understand that the hardest problems in quality are not technical alone: they require shifting culture, earning trust across organizations you do not own, and making the right thing easier than the wrong thing. You are energized by ambiguity, comfortable operating across VP-level organizations through influence rather than authority, and relentless about simplifying complexity for the people who use what you build.

About the team
EQT's vision is to embed experience quality into every stage of software development at Amazon, making it effortless for builders to achieve and an undeniable outcome for every customer. We serve two customers equally: builders, for whom we make shipping with confidence the default path, and Amazon's end customers, who should be able to rely on what we ship regardless of ability, device, or context.

Our work spans the full quality lifecycle: defining quality standards, preventing defects in the tools builders already use, verifying that output meets the bar before it ships, and monitoring production signals that sharpen the bar again. We move fast, we partner before we build, and we hold the bar because we believe in what it protects.
